content.title: OVERVIEW
content.description:
Originally known as Gloucester House, Nº149 Old Park Lane is a sophisticated landmark building with an important role in London’s architectural heritage.

Situated on the corner of Old Park Lane and Piccadilly, overlooking Green Park. Nº149 is one of the finest Grade II properties on Old Park Lane. It has been meticulously redeveloped and designed to the highest of standards throughout.

content.title: A MOMENTOUS WELCOME
content.description:
Welcoming residents and guests since a century, the charmingly historical entrance of Nº149 has retained many of the classical and Art Nouveau features of the original design.

This exquisite period building has an elevator, a 24-hr porterage and concierge services, blending tradition with every contemporary convenience.

content.title: GRAND FOYER
content.description:
Upon entering the apartment, residents and guests are met with 14-feet high ceilings and spacious corridors.

The intricate interior design entwined with classic contemporary pieces create a traditional feel that is continued throughout the property.

content.title: THE RECEPTION HALL
content.description:
With windows overlooking London’s iconic Green Park, the reception hall is one of Nº149 Old Park Lane’s grandest rooms.

Designed as two spaces, the reception hall offers both a formal and informal setting. A crystal chandelier hangs from the ceiling, surrounded by exquisite cream, beige and dark walnut furnishings.

content.title: FORMAL DINING
content.description:
The formal dining room enjoys views of Old Park Lane with grand proportions and beautifully detailed finishing.

It retains its historic ambiance with its intricate cornicing, bespoke table and joinery pieces, accented with a modern classic furnishing.

An original fireplace completes this elegant room.

content.title: THE KITCHEN
content.description:
The open-plan kitchen and informal dining room benefits from an abundance of natural light and has been designed to allow guests and residents to seamlessly migrate towards the spacious entertaining and living space.

The informal dining features a bespoke mahogany table, whilst the kitchen is fitted with top-of-the-range appliances and marble countertops.

content.title: THE MASTER BEDROOM
content.description:
This palatial master bedroom suite boasts vast proportions and imposing grandeur.

The bed is positioned in the centre of the room with a part height feature partition wall disguising the floor to ceiling joinery behind. The room also benefits from his and her walk-in dressing rooms and en-suite bathrooms.

An imperial chandelier sits over the bed and the room is brought together with intricately detailed furnishings.

content.title: MORE THAN AN ADDRESS
content.description:
Nº149 is situated on the corner of Old Park Lane and Piccadilly, overlooking Green Park and in close proximity to Hyde Park Corner, Sloane Street, Buckingham Palace, and both underground and overground transport links.

It is also within close proximity to all of the amenities that Knightsbridge, Belgravia and Mayfair have to offer.

World-renowned hotels such as the Ritz, and the Mandarin are at your doorstep as well as excellent options for dining, entertainment, culture and shopping such as Harrods and Harvey Nichols.

content.title: SIDE BY SIDE
content.description: The Painite Villas are the only villas in the South of Spain with the exclusive Sky Car Lift with technology by Automobili Lamborghini. Located in the hills of Benahavis, overlooking Marbella, the Painite Villas rise out from the hills, offering panoramic views of the Mediterranean Sea and the Andalusian landscape. The villas fitted with Automobili Lamborghini interiors have their very own private car elevator. The Sky Car Lift has access to both levels of the villa, seamlessly integrating your supercar into your living space.

content.title: PRIVATE SKY CAR LIFT
content.description: The entrance to the Painite Villa is nothing short of breathtaking. As you drive into the villa via the Sky Car Lift, you're enveloped in a protective glass dome that offers a stunning 360-degree view of your supercar. Inside, you're greeted by spacious, light-filled interiors where floor-to-ceiling windows seamlessly blend the indoors with the outdoors. Here, your supercar is the centerpiece, showcased like a piece of art against the magnificent backdrop of the Mediterranean Sea.

content.title: THE VILLA
content.description: The villa boasts six luxurious bedrooms, expansive roof terraces, and panoramic views of the Mediterranean Sea from every angle. Complementing this are the extensive swimming pool and lush, meticulously designed gardens, making the villa a gateway to unparalleled luxury.

content.title: THE VIEWS
content.description: The Painite Villas are masterfully positioned on the hilltops, where careful leveling ensures that each villa enjoys unobstructed, panoramic views. From this elevated vantage point, the villas offer breathtaking vistas that stretch across the horizon, providing an uninterrupted connection to the surrounding landscape. The strategic placement of these villas maximizes the stunning scenery and creates a sense of serenity and exclusivity.

content.title: THE AMENITIES
content.description: Each villa features expansive roof terraces that provide an ideal setting for relaxation or entertaining, all while enjoying panoramic views of the Mediterranean Sea from every angle. The outdoor space is thoughtfully designed, offering a perfect spot for a pool if desired, and is surrounded by meticulously landscaped luxury gardens that offer a serene escape. Every aspect of these villas is crafted to create a harmonious blend of luxury, comfort, and natural beauty.

content.title: OVERVIEW
content.description:
Originally known as Gloucester House, Nº149 Old Park Lane is a sophisticated landmark building with an important role in London’s architectural heritage.

Situated on the corner of Old Park Lane and Piccadilly, overlooking Green Park. Nº149 is one of the finest Grade II properties on Old Park Lane. It has been meticulously redeveloped and designed to the highest of standards throughout.

content.title: A MOMENTOUS WELCOME
content.description:
Welcoming residents and guests since a century, the charmingly historical entrance of Nº149 has retained many of the classical and Art Nouveau features of the original design.

This exquisite period building has an elevator, a 24-hr porterage and concierge services, blending tradition with every contemporary convenience.

content.title: GRAND FOYER
content.description:
Upon entering the apartment, residents and guests are met with 14-feet high ceilings and spacious corridors.

The intricate interior design entwined with classic contemporary pieces create a traditional feel that is continued throughout the property.

content.title: THE RECEPTION HALL
content.description:
With windows overlooking London’s iconic Green Park, the reception hall is one of Nº149 Old Park Lane’s grandest rooms.

Designed as two spaces, the reception hall offers both a formal and informal setting. A crystal chandelier hangs from the ceiling, surrounded by exquisite cream, beige and dark walnut furnishings.

content.title: FORMAL DINING
content.description:
The formal dining room enjoys views of Old Park Lane with grand proportions and beautifully detailed finishing.

It retains its historic ambiance with its intricate cornicing, bespoke table and joinery pieces, accented with a modern classic furnishing.

An original fireplace completes this elegant room.

content.title: THE KITCHEN
content.description:
The open-plan kitchen and informal dining room benefits from an abundance of natural light and has been designed to allow guests and residents to seamlessly migrate towards the spacious entertaining and living space.

The informal dining features a bespoke mahogany table, whilst the kitchen is fitted with top-of-the-range appliances and marble countertops.

content.title: THE MASTER BEDROOM
content.description:
This palatial master bedroom suite boasts vast proportions and imposing grandeur.

The bed is positioned in the centre of the room with a part height feature partition wall disguising the floor to ceiling joinery behind. The room also benefits from his and her walk-in dressing rooms and en-suite bathrooms.

An imperial chandelier sits over the bed and the room is brought together with intricately detailed furnishings.

content.title: MORE THAN AN ADDRESS
content.description:
Nº149 is situated on the corner of Old Park Lane and Piccadilly, overlooking Green Park and in close proximity to Hyde Park Corner, Sloane Street, Buckingham Palace, and both underground and overground transport links.

It is also within close proximity to all of the amenities that Knightsbridge, Belgravia and Mayfair have to offer.

World-renowned hotels such as the Ritz, and the Mandarin are at your doorstep as well as excellent options for dining, entertainment, culture and shopping such as Harrods and Harvey Nichols.

content.title: Albert Hall Mansions History
content.description: Albert Hall Mansions, nestled in the heart of London, is an iconic residential complex with a rich Victorian heritage. Designed by renowned architect Richard Norman Shaw, construction began in 1879 and concluded in 1886, marking a milestone in London’s architectural evolution. Among the city’s first luxury apartments, it catered to Victorian elites. Its red-brick façade, ornate terracotta details, and grand gables epitomize the Queen Anne revival style. Home to notable figures over the years, it remains a symbol of prestige and timeless elegance.

content.title: A Unique Duplex
content.description: The Albert Hall Mansion is an exquisite duplex on the 3rd and 4th floor of Albert Hall Mansions, a flawless residential creation in the heart of London. This completely refurbished unit featuring décor by Loro Piana Interiors delicately brings together a seamless dialogue between the exteriors and interiors of the residence, combining modern design with timeless charm.

content.title: Decor by Loro Piana Interiors
content.description: This duplex has been transformed into the magnum opus of bespoke interior design that blends into the legacy of the residence’s surroundings. Known worldwide for their luxurious textiles, refined aesthetic and subtle color palette, Loro Piana Interiors brings a level of sophistication and elegance that is evident in every detail. Their commitment to excellence ensures that each bespoke element of the duplex, from the furniture to the exquisite fabrics, meets the highest standards of luxury, functionality and comfort.

content.title: A prestigious Address
content.description: The Albert Hall Mansion is situated in one of London’s most prestigious neighborhoods, directly overlooking the iconic Royal Albert Hall. This historic and architecturally significant building offers residents breathtaking views as well as an exclusive address. The location provides the perfect balance between the vibrant energy of city life and the tranquility of a refined residential area.

content.title: The Entrance
content.description: The duplex welcomes you with an elegant entrance hall leading into a spacious living room, ideal for both relaxation and entertaining. The dining room, adorned with bespoke furnishings and rich fabrics, offers a refined setting for formal gatherings, while the family room provides a cozy retreat. A state-of-the-art kitchen, equipped with premium appliances, enhances culinary experiences. This floor also features a guest bedroom with an en-suite for privacy and comfort, along with a well-appointed maid’s quarters for seamless service.

content.title: The Private Quarters
content.description: The second floor of the duplex is dedicated to private quarters, offering a serene retreat. The master suite is a true sanctuary, featuring two walk-in closets crafted from the finest materials and two en-suite bathrooms designed for spa-like relaxation. Alongside the master suite, three elegantly appointed bedrooms provide comfort and style, each thoughtfully furnished to offer a refined living experience for family members or guests.

content.title: Reception Room
content.description: This expansive space is the heart of the home, designed for both relaxation and entertaining. At its center, the magnificent Palm Sofa, upholstered in sumptuous Mohair velvet, is flanked by four Palm Armchairs in Sherpas Cashmere, creating a cohesive and stylish seating arrangement. Floor-length curtains in Alizé linen-cotton and Bora Bora silk-linen frame the windows, inviting natural light. The St. Emilion rug, woven from fine wool, adds sophistication, while curated accessories enhance the room’s elegance, texture, and warmth.

content.title: Formal Dining
content.description: At the heart of the formal dining room, the exquisite Sarto chairs, upholstered in Sherpas cashmere and striped velvet, offer both comfort and luxury, inviting guests to linger. The dining table, a masterpiece of craftsmanship, sits atop the elegant Delamere wool-silk rug, adding a refined touch. Floor-length curtains enhance the ambiance, casting a warm, intimate glow in the evening, completing the room’s sophisticated atmosphere.

content.title: The studio
content.description: This elegantly designed studio blends functionality with luxury, creating a perfect space for both productivity and relaxation. At its center, the Palm Duet Chaise Longue in Sherpas cashmere, paired with its Ottoman, faces the desk and bespoke chairs. Casanova jute wallcovering adds a refined backdrop, enhancing focus and creativity, while the Delamere wool-silk rug brings warmth and sophistication to the space.

paragraphs: The Painite Villas are the only villas in the South of Spain with the exclusive Sky Car Lift with technology by Automobili Lamborghini. Located in the hills of Benahavis, overlooking Marbella, the Painite Villas rise out from the hills, offering panoramic views of the Mediterranean Sea and the Andalusian landscape. The villas fitted with Automobili Lamborghini interiors have their very own private car elevator. The Sky Car Lift has access to both levels of the villa, seamlessly integrating your supercar into your living space.

The entrance to the Painite Villa is nothing short of breathtaking. As you drive into the villa via the Sky Car Lift, you're enveloped in a protective glass dome that offers a stunning 360-degree view of your supercar. Inside, you're greeted by spacious, light-filled interiors where floor-to-ceiling windows seamlessly blend the indoors with the outdoors. Here, your supercar is the centerpiece, showcased like a piece of art against the magnificent backdrop of the Mediterranean Sea.

The villa boasts six luxurious bedrooms, expansive roof terraces, and panoramic views of the Mediterranean Sea from every angle. Complementing this are the extensive swimming pool and lush, meticulously designed gardens, making the villa a gateway to unparalleled luxury.

The Painite Villas are masterfully positioned on the hilltops, where careful leveling ensures that each villa enjoys unobstructed, panoramic views. From this elevated vantage point, the villas offer breathtaking vistas that stretch across the horizon, providing an uninterrupted connection to the surrounding landscape. The strategic placement of these villas maximizes the stunning scenery and creates a sense of serenity and exclusivity.

Each villa features expansive roof terraces that provide an ideal setting for relaxation or entertaining, all while enjoying panoramic views of the Mediterranean Sea from every angle. The outdoor space is thoughtfully designed, offering a perfect spot for a pool if desired, and is surrounded by meticulously landscaped luxury gardens that offer a serene escape. Every aspect of these villas is crafted to create a harmonious blend of luxury, comfort, and natural beauty.

The Painite Villas are located in Tierra Viva in Marbella, one of the most affluent locations around the world. Home to the most stylish clubs, restaurants and hotels, as well as, shopping areas, exclusive marinas and breathtaking beaches. The villas are precisely nestled in the hills, only minutes away from the shores and in close proximity to 9 golf clubs, numerous Andalusian villages and Puerto Banus.

content.title: OVERVIEW
content.description:
Originally known as Gloucester House, Nº149 Old Park Lane is a sophisticated landmark building with an important role in London’s architectural heritage.

Situated on the corner of Old Park Lane and Piccadilly, overlooking Green Park. Nº149 is one of the finest Grade II properties on Old Park Lane. It has been meticulously redeveloped and designed to the highest of standards throughout.

content.title: A MOMENTOUS WELCOME
content.description:
Welcoming residents and guests since a century, the charmingly historical entrance of Nº149 has retained many of the classical and Art Nouveau features of the original design.

This exquisite period building has an elevator, a 24-hr porterage and concierge services, blending tradition with every contemporary convenience.

content.title: GRAND FOYER
content.description:
Upon entering the apartment, residents and guests are met with 14-feet high ceilings and spacious corridors.

The intricate interior design entwined with classic contemporary pieces create a traditional feel that is continued throughout the property.

content.title: THE RECEPTION HALL
content.description:
With windows overlooking London’s iconic Green Park, the reception hall is one of Nº149 Old Park Lane’s grandest rooms.

Designed as two spaces, the reception hall offers both a formal and informal setting. A crystal chandelier hangs from the ceiling, surrounded by exquisite cream, beige and dark walnut furnishings.

content.title: FORMAL DINING
content.description:
The formal dining room enjoys views of Old Park Lane with grand proportions and beautifully detailed finishing.

It retains its historic ambiance with its intricate cornicing, bespoke table and joinery pieces, accented with a modern classic furnishing.

An original fireplace completes this elegant room.

content.title: THE KITCHEN
content.description:
The open-plan kitchen and informal dining room benefits from an abundance of natural light and has been designed to allow guests and residents to seamlessly migrate towards the spacious entertaining and living space.

The informal dining features a bespoke mahogany table, whilst the kitchen is fitted with top-of-the-range appliances and marble countertops.

content.title: THE MASTER BEDROOM
content.description:
This palatial master bedroom suite boasts vast proportions and imposing grandeur.

The bed is positioned in the centre of the room with a part height feature partition wall disguising the floor to ceiling joinery behind. The room also benefits from his and her walk-in dressing rooms and en-suite bathrooms.

An imperial chandelier sits over the bed and the room is brought together with intricately detailed furnishings.

content.title: MORE THAN AN ADDRESS
content.description:
Nº149 is situated on the corner of Old Park Lane and Piccadilly, overlooking Green Park and in close proximity to Hyde Park Corner, Sloane Street, Buckingham Palace, and both underground and overground transport links.

It is also within close proximity to all of the amenities that Knightsbridge, Belgravia and Mayfair have to offer.

World-renowned hotels such as the Ritz, and the Mandarin are at your doorstep as well as excellent options for dining, entertainment, culture and shopping such as Harrods and Harvey Nichols. 

[Get in touch](https://darglobal.co.uk/get-in-touch)

The bed is positioned in the centre of the room with a part height feature partition wall disguising the floor to ceiling joinery behind. The room also benefits from his and her walk-in dressing rooms and en-suite bathrooms.

An imperial chandelier sits over the bed and the room is brought together with intricately detailed furnishings.

content.title: Albert Hall Mansions History
content.description: Albert Hall Mansions, nestled in the heart of London, is an iconic residential complex with a rich Victorian heritage. Designed by renowned architect Richard Norman Shaw, construction began in 1879 and concluded in 1886, marking a milestone in London’s architectural evolution. Among the city’s first luxury apartments, it catered to Victorian elites. Its red-brick façade, ornate terracotta details, and grand gables epitomize the Queen Anne revival style. Home to notable figures over the years, it remains a symbol of prestige and timeless elegance.

content.title: A Unique Duplex
content.description: The Albert Hall Mansion is an exquisite duplex on the 3rd and 4th floor of Albert Hall Mansions, a flawless residential creation in the heart of London. This completely refurbished unit featuring décor by Loro Piana Interiors delicately brings together a seamless dialogue between the exteriors and interiors of the residence, combining modern design with timeless charm.

content.title: Decor by Loro Piana Interiors
content.description: This duplex has been transformed into the magnum opus of bespoke interior design that blends into the legacy of the residence’s surroundings. Known worldwide for their luxurious textiles, refined aesthetic and subtle color palette, Loro Piana Interiors brings a level of sophistication and elegance that is evident in every detail. Their commitment to excellence ensures that each bespoke element of the duplex, from the furniture to the exquisite fabrics, meets the highest standards of luxury, functionality and comfort.

content.title: A prestigious Address

This historic and architecturally significant building offers residents breathtaking views as well as an exclusive address. The location provides the perfect balance between the vibrant energy of city life and the tranquility of a refined residential area.

content.title: The Entrance
content.description: The duplex welcomes you with an elegant entrance hall leading into a spacious living room, ideal for both relaxation and entertaining. The dining room, adorned with bespoke furnishings and rich fabrics, offers a refined setting for formal gatherings, while the family room provides a cozy retreat. A state-of-the-art kitchen, equipped with premium appliances, enhances culinary experiences. This floor also features a guest bedroom with an en-suite for privacy and comfort, along with a well-appointed maid’s quarters for seamless service.

content.title: The Private Quarters
content.description: The second floor of the duplex is dedicated to private quarters, offering a serene retreat. The master suite is a true sanctuary, featuring two walk-in closets crafted from the finest materials and two en-suite bathrooms designed for spa-like relaxation. Alongside the master suite, three elegantly appointed bedrooms provide comfort and style, each thoughtfully furnished to offer a refined living experience for family members or guests.

content.title: Reception Room
content.description: This expansive space is the heart of the home, designed for both relaxation and entertaining. At its center, the magnificent Palm Sofa, upholstered in sumptuous Mohair velvet, is flanked by four Palm Armchairs in Sherpas Cashmere, creating a cohesive and stylish seating arrangement. Floor-length curtains in Alizé linen-cotton and Bora Bora silk-linen frame the windows, inviting natural light. The St. Emilion rug, woven from fine wool, adds sophistication, while curated accessories enhance the room’s elegance, texture, and warmth.

content.title: Formal Dining
content.description: At the heart of the formal dining room, the exquisite Sarto chairs, upholstered in Sherpas cashmere and striped velvet, offer both comfort and luxury, inviting guests to linger. The dining table, a masterpiece of craftsmanship, sits atop the elegant Delamere wool-silk rug, adding a refined touch. Floor-length curtains enhance the ambiance, casting a warm, intimate glow in the evening, completing the room’s sophisticated atmosphere.

content.title: The studio
content.description: This elegantly designed studio blends functionality with luxury, creating a perfect space for both productivity and relaxation. At its center, the Palm Duet Chaise Longue in Sherpas cashmere, paired with its Ottoman, faces the desk and bespoke chairs. Casanova jute wallcovering adds a refined backdrop, enhancing focus and creativity, while the Delamere wool-silk rug brings warmth and sophistication to the space.

I intend to purchase a residential unit of DarGlobal(“Developer”) and make this online payment(“Token Amount”) towards the initial deposit, for the reservation of the unit(“Reservation”).

 Following this, the Reservation of the unit will be confirmed by the Developer through an official e-mail, subject to the availability of the requested unit at the time of Reservation. 

 I understand and agree that payment of the Token Amount does not ensure the availability of the requested unit. 

 I understand and agree that the payment excludes all applicable bank charges, fees, taxes, and / or commissions.

 I understand and agree that this payment is non - refundable; however, the Developer may agree to issue a refund in its sole discretion.In such cases, refunds will be issued through the original mode of payment.

 I understand and agree that this payment cannot be used in lieu of any other payments due to DarGlobal, this includes payment of any balance, and / or deposits, and / or subsequent instalment(s) due for a reserved or purchased unit
descriptionArray.description3:

Before the expiry of the Reservation Period, the Customer must pay in full to the Developer, the initial instalment (the “Deposit”) of the purchase price, in addition to signing the Developer’s sale and purchase agreement for the unit (the “SPA”).

 If the Customer fails to pay the Deposit in full and/or sign the SPA within the Reservation Period for any reason whatsoever, the Reservation shall automatically terminate and the Token Amount, along with any other payments made towards the Deposit, shall be forfeited to the Developer, without need for notice, court judgment or any further proceedings (legal or otherwise).

attributes.description: Situated on the corner of Old Park Lane and Piccadilly, overlooking Green Park. Nº149 is one of the finest Grade II properties on Old Park Lane. It has been meticulously redeveloped and designed to the highest of standards throughout.

SEO.metaTitle: Buy Branded Homes | Million Dollar Houses for Sale | Darglobal
SEO.metaDescription: Explore the Premiere Edition Collection by DarGlobal— Million-dollar houses for sale in the world’s most prestigious locations. Own a rare branded home today!

content.title: OVERVIEW
content.description:
Originally known as Gloucester House, Nº149 Old Park Lane is a sophisticated landmark building with an important role in London’s architectural heritage.

Situated on the corner of Old Park Lane and Piccadilly, overlooking Green Park. Nº149 is one of the finest Grade II properties on Old Park Lane. It has been meticulously redeveloped and designed to the highest of standards throughout.

content.title: A MOMENTOUS WELCOME
content.description:
Welcoming residents and guests since a century, the charmingly historical entrance of Nº149 has retained many of the classical and Art Nouveau features of the original design.

This exquisite period building has an elevator, a 24-hr porterage and concierge services, blending tradition with every contemporary convenience.

content.title: GRAND FOYER
content.description:
Upon entering the apartment, residents and guests are met with 14-feet high ceilings and spacious corridors.

The intricate interior design entwined with classic contemporary pieces create a traditional feel that is continued throughout the property.

content.title: THE RECEPTION HALL
content.description:
With windows overlooking London’s iconic Green Park, the reception hall is one of Nº149 Old Park Lane’s grandest rooms.

Designed as two spaces, the reception hall offers both a formal and informal setting. A crystal chandelier hangs from the ceiling, surrounded by exquisite cream, beige and dark walnut furnishings.

content.title: FORMAL DINING
content.description:
The formal dining room enjoys views of Old Park Lane with grand proportions and beautifully detailed finishing.

It retains its historic ambiance with its intricate cornicing, bespoke table and joinery pieces, accented with a modern classic furnishing.

An original fireplace completes this elegant room.

content.title: THE KITCHEN
content.description:
The open-plan kitchen and informal dining room benefits from an abundance of natural light and has been designed to allow guests and residents to seamlessly migrate towards the spacious entertaining and living space.

The informal dining features a bespoke mahogany table, whilst the kitchen is fitted with top-of-the-range appliances and marble countertops.

content.title: THE MASTER BEDROOM
content.description:
This palatial master bedroom suite boasts vast proportions and imposing grandeur.

The bed is positioned in the centre of the room with a part height feature partition wall disguising the floor to ceiling joinery behind. The room also benefits from his and her walk-in dressing rooms and en-suite bathrooms.

An imperial chandelier sits over the bed and the room is brought together with intricately detailed furnishings.

content.title: MORE THAN AN ADDRESS
content.description:
Nº149 is situated on the corner of Old Park Lane and Piccadilly, overlooking Green Park and in close proximity to Hyde Park Corner, Sloane Street, Buckingham Palace, and both underground and overground transport links.

It is also within close proximity to all of the amenities that Knightsbridge, Belgravia and Mayfair have to offer.

World-renowned hotels such as the Ritz, and the Mandarin are at your doorstep as well as excellent options for dining, entertainment, culture and shopping such as Harrods and Harvey Nichols. 

[Get in touch](https://darglobal.co.uk/get-in-touch)

SEO.metaTitle: Buy Pagani Penthouses in Dubai UAE | DarGlobal

content.title: OVERVIEW
content.description: Pagani’s essence has taken shape, for the first time in the world, in a residential building in the heart of Dubai. The culmination of the first ever living experience, by the super automaker is the Penthouse. Spanning 14,428 sq ft, where every square foot is worthy of a masterpiece.

content.title: LIVING IN THE SPHERE
content.description: The expansive residence extending the entire top floor is accented with the most unique feature of the penthouse, the sphere. A sphere completely constructed with geometric glass panes to give you 360 degree views, from the sweeping Dubai Canal to Downtown Dubai.

content.title: ELEVATING THE STANDARDS OF LIVING
content.description: Residents and guests arrive at the Pagani Penthouse in its very own personal elevator. After being welcomed inside, advanced domotics are available to respond to their every touch.

content.title: THE LIVING SPACES
content.description: A timeless interpretation of automotive art. The living spaces are designed with heritage leather, and luxurious fabrics that are reminiscent to the interiors of a Pagani car.

content.title: THE PERSONAL SPACES
content.description: Traces of the Italian supercar are steeped in hushed tones of the bedrooms, and en-suite bathrooms. The rooms are reminiscent of the ultra-modern interiors of the Pagani, serene and victorious.

content.title: LOCATION
content.description:
The Pagani Penthouse is perched on The DaVinci Tower, which sits at the heart of Dubai’s cultural district, surrounded by prominent landmarks, such as the Dubai Opera, exhibition centres, design houses, art galleries, and affluent neighbourhoods. This gives you the perfect opportunity to explore various shopping, dining, and cultural experiences by the Dubai Canal, Business Bay and Burj Khalifa.

attributes.title: Painite Villas Design Inspired by Automobili Lamborghini
attributes.description: The Painite Villas are luxurious six-bedroom villas located in the south of Spain, featuring exclusive Sky Car Lift technology by Automobili Lamborghini and offering panoramic views of the Mediterranean Sea.

SEO.metaTitle: Painite Villas in Benahavis | Benahavis Property | DarGlobal
SEO.metaDescription: Discover Painite Villas in Benahavis — luxury homes featuring the Lamborghini Sky Car Lift, sleek interiors and panoramic Mediterranean views over Marbella’s scenic hills.

content.title: SIDE BY SIDE
content.description: The Painite Villas are the only villas in the South of Spain with the exclusive Sky Car Lift with technology by Automobili Lamborghini. Located in the hills of Benahavis, overlooking Marbella, the Painite Villas rise out from the hills, offering panoramic views of the Mediterranean Sea and the Andalusian landscape. The villas fitted with Automobili Lamborghini interiors have their very own private car elevator. The Sky Car Lift has access to both levels of the villa, seamlessly integrating your supercar into your living space.

content.title: PRIVATE SKY CAR LIFT
content.description: The entrance to the Painite Villa is nothing short of breathtaking. As you drive into the villa via the Sky Car Lift, you're enveloped in a protective glass dome that offers a stunning 360-degree view of your supercar. Inside, you're greeted by spacious, light-filled interiors where floor-to-ceiling windows seamlessly blend the indoors with the outdoors. Here, your supercar is the centerpiece, showcased like a piece of art against the magnificent backdrop of the Mediterranean Sea.

content.title: THE VILLA
content.description: The villa boasts six luxurious bedrooms, expansive roof terraces, and panoramic views of the Mediterranean Sea from every angle. Complementing this are the extensive swimming pool and lush, meticulously designed gardens, making the villa a gateway to unparalleled luxury.

content.title: THE VIEWS
content.description: The Painite Villas are masterfully positioned on the hilltops, where careful leveling ensures that each villa enjoys unobstructed, panoramic views. From this elevated vantage point, the villas offer breathtaking vistas that stretch across the horizon, providing an uninterrupted connection to the surrounding landscape. The strategic placement of these villas maximizes the stunning scenery and creates a sense of serenity and exclusivity.

content.title: THE AMENITIES
content.description: Each villa features expansive roof terraces that provide an ideal setting for relaxation or entertaining, all while enjoying panoramic views of the Mediterranean Sea from every angle. The outdoor space is thoughtfully designed, offering a perfect spot for a pool if desired, and is surrounded by meticulously landscaped luxury gardens that offer a serene escape. Every aspect of these villas is crafted to create a harmonious blend of luxury, comfort, and natural beauty.

content.title: LOCATION

content.title: OVERVIEW
content.description:
Originally known as Gloucester House, Nº149 Old Park Lane is a sophisticated landmark building with an important role in London’s architectural heritage.

Situated on the corner of Old Park Lane and Piccadilly, overlooking Green Park. Nº149 is one of the finest Grade II properties on Old Park Lane. It has been meticulously redeveloped and designed to the highest of standards throughout.

content.title: A MOMENTOUS WELCOME
content.description:
Welcoming residents and guests since a century, the charmingly historical entrance of Nº149 has retained many of the classical and Art Nouveau features of the original design.

This exquisite period building has an elevator, a 24-hr porterage and concierge services, blending tradition with every contemporary convenience.

content.title: GRAND FOYER
content.description:
Upon entering the apartment, residents and guests are met with 14-feet high ceilings and spacious corridors.

The intricate interior design entwined with classic contemporary pieces create a traditional feel that is continued throughout the property.

content.title: THE RECEPTION HALL
content.description:
With windows overlooking London’s iconic Green Park, the reception hall is one of Nº149 Old Park Lane’s grandest rooms.

Designed as two spaces, the reception hall offers both a formal and informal setting. A crystal chandelier hangs from the ceiling, surrounded by exquisite cream, beige and dark walnut furnishings.

content.title: FORMAL DINING
content.description:
The formal dining room enjoys views of Old Park Lane with grand proportions and beautifully detailed finishing.

It retains its historic ambiance with its intricate cornicing, bespoke table and joinery pieces, accented with a modern classic furnishing.

An original fireplace completes this elegant room.

content.title: THE KITCHEN
content.description:
The open-plan kitchen and informal dining room benefits from an abundance of natural light and has been designed to allow guests and residents to seamlessly migrate towards the spacious entertaining and living space.

The informal dining features a bespoke mahogany table, whilst the kitchen is fitted with top-of-the-range appliances and marble countertops.

content.title: THE MASTER BEDROOM
content.description:
This palatial master bedroom suite boasts vast proportions and imposing grandeur.

The bed is positioned in the centre of the room with a part height feature partition wall disguising the floor to ceiling joinery behind. The room also benefits from his and her walk-in dressing rooms and en-suite bathrooms.

An imperial chandelier sits over the bed and the room is brought together with intricately detailed furnishings.

content.title: MORE THAN AN ADDRESS
content.description:
Nº149 is situated on the corner of Old Park Lane and Piccadilly, overlooking Green Park and in close proximity to Hyde Park Corner, Sloane Street, Buckingham Palace, and both underground and overground transport links.

It is also within close proximity to all of the amenities that Knightsbridge, Belgravia and Mayfair have to offer.

World-renowned hotels such as the Ritz, and the Mandarin are at your doorstep as well as excellent options for dining, entertainment, culture and shopping such as Harrods and Harvey Nichols.

content.title: Albert Hall Mansions History
content.description: Albert Hall Mansions, nestled in the heart of London, is an iconic residential complex with a rich Victorian heritage. Designed by renowned architect Richard Norman Shaw, construction began in 1879 and concluded in 1886, marking a milestone in London’s architectural evolution. Among the city’s first luxury apartments, it catered to Victorian elites. Its red-brick façade, ornate terracotta details, and grand gables epitomize the Queen Anne revival style. Home to notable figures over the years, it remains a symbol of prestige and timeless elegance.

content.title: A Unique Duplex
content.description: The Albert Hall Mansion is an exquisite duplex on the 3rd and 4th floor of Albert Hall Mansions, a flawless residential creation in the heart of London. This completely refurbished unit featuring décor by Loro Piana Interiors delicately brings together a seamless dialogue between the exteriors and interiors of the residence, combining modern design with timeless charm.

content.title: Decor by Loro Piana Interiors
content.description: This duplex has been transformed into the magnum opus of bespoke interior design that blends into the legacy of the residence’s surroundings. Known worldwide for their luxurious textiles, refined aesthetic and subtle color palette, Loro Piana Interiors brings a level of sophistication and elegance that is evident in every detail. Their commitment to excellence ensures that each bespoke element of the duplex, from the furniture to the exquisite fabrics, meets the highest standards of luxury, functionality and comfort.

content.title: A prestigious Address
content.description: The Albert Hall Mansion is situated in one of London’s most prestigious neighborhoods, directly overlooking the iconic Royal Albert Hall. This historic and architecturally significant building offers residents breathtaking views as well as an exclusive address. The location provides the perfect balance between the vibrant energy of city life and the tranquility of a refined residential area.

content.title: The Entrance
content.description: The duplex welcomes you with an elegant entrance hall leading into a spacious living room, ideal for both relaxation and entertaining. The dining room, adorned with bespoke furnishings and rich fabrics, offers a refined setting for formal gatherings, while the family room provides a cozy retreat. A state-of-the-art kitchen, equipped with premium appliances, enhances culinary experiences. This floor also features a guest bedroom with an en-suite for privacy and comfort, along with a well-appointed maid’s quarters for seamless service.

content.title: The Private Quarters
content.description: The second floor of the duplex is dedicated to private quarters, offering a serene retreat. The master suite is a true sanctuary, featuring two walk-in closets crafted from the finest materials and two en-suite bathrooms designed for spa-like relaxation. Alongside the master suite, three elegantly appointed bedrooms provide comfort and style, each thoughtfully furnished to offer a refined living experience for family members or guests.

content.title: Reception Room
content.description: This expansive space is the heart of the home, designed for both relaxation and entertaining. At its center, the magnificent Palm Sofa, upholstered in sumptuous Mohair velvet, is flanked by four Palm Armchairs in Sherpas Cashmere, creating a cohesive and stylish seating arrangement. Floor-length curtains in Alizé linen-cotton and Bora Bora silk-linen frame the windows, inviting natural light. The St. Emilion rug, woven from fine wool, adds sophistication, while curated accessories enhance the room’s elegance, texture, and warmth.

content.title: Formal Dining
content.description: At the heart of the formal dining room, the exquisite Sarto chairs, upholstered in Sherpas cashmere and striped velvet, offer both comfort and luxury, inviting guests to linger. The dining table, a masterpiece of craftsmanship, sits atop the elegant Delamere wool-silk rug, adding a refined touch. Floor-length curtains enhance the ambiance, casting a warm, intimate glow in the evening, completing the room’s sophisticated atmosphere.

content.title: The studio
content.description: This elegantly designed studio blends functionality with luxury, creating a perfect space for both productivity and relaxation. At its center, the Palm Duet Chaise Longue in Sherpas cashmere, paired with its Ottoman, faces the desk and bespoke chairs. Casanova jute wallcovering adds a refined backdrop, enhancing focus and creativity, while the Delamere wool-silk rug brings warmth and sophistication to the space.

text:
## First row to nature’s beauty. Nineteen pieces above the sea
Azure Oceanfront Villas is a limited collection of five-bedroom residences, suspended 130 meters above the sea, inside AIDA, Oman’s most prestigious gated coastal community. Interiors by FENDI Casa. Nothing in front of you. Nothing above you. Only the horizon.
## A gated enclave within a gated community
Azure occupies the highest and most discreet zone within AIDA. Privately gated. Limited in number. Built for distance. Designed for discretion.
## Interiors by FENDI Casa
Interiors reflect the brand’s signature approach to craftsmanship and detail, combining refined materials with a contemporary design language. Custom furnishings, sculptural elements, and curated finishes create spaces that are both functional and expressive.
## THE VILLAS SPECS
Five-bedroom villas designed with a focus on proportion, functionality, and material quality.
Key features include:
• Branded interiors by FENDI Casa  
• Open-plan living and dining areas  
• Bespoke finishes and materials  
• Expansive glazing to maximise natural light  
• Carefully planned layouts for privacy and flow
Each villa is composed to balance design clarity with everyday usability.
## LIVING EXPERIENCE
Each residence includes private outdoor spaces designed as extensions of the interior.
• Expansive terraces  
• Landscaped gardens  
• Infinity-edge swimming pools
These elements are positioned to create continuity between indoor and outdoor living.
## THE VIEWS
All villas are oriented toward the sea, ensuring uninterrupted views of the horizon. There are no structures above or in front, allowing full visual openness and a direct connection to the surrounding landscape.
## LOCATION
AIDA is a gated clifftop community overlooking the Gulf of Oman, spanning over 4.3 million sqm.
The city integrates residential, golfing, and hospitality components, including:
• Trump International Golf Club  
• Luxury hotels and resorts  
• Beaches and coastal access  
• Wellness and outdoor facilities
Located approximately 25 minutes from Muscat International Airport, AIDA offers both accessibility and seclusion.

title: Da Vinci Tower | Pagani Residences, Dubai | DarGlobal
paragraphs: Da Vinci Tower is the world's first residences by Pagani, a branded residential tower in Downtown Dubai, developed by DarGlobal with interiors crafted by Pagani Automobili. An architectural marvel designed to captivate, its striking façade is balanced on a one-of-a-kind geometric structure that creates a dynamic visual effect commanding attention. At its heart lies the pearl, a suspended sphere that adds a touch of wonder to this masterpiece. Rising 19 floors above the Dubai Canal, with three basement levels and a grand ground floor, the tower offers an unmatched view of the iconic Burj Khalifa and sits just moments from Marasi Business Bay. Its 2, 3 and 4-bedroom residences range from 77 to 398 sq m, with opulent interiors by Pagani that embody the meticulous artistry and innovation inspired by Leonardo da Vinci himself. This landmark Pagani residence is a tribute to the timeless genius that shaped both Pagani's vision and these extraordinary homes.

The luxurious residences redefine living standards with 2-to-4-bedroom marble-accented homes, featuring private outdoor areas, light-filled interiors, and panoramic views of the canal and Downtown Dubai. These meticulously designed spaces combine elegance and functionality, offering an unparalleled living experience.

descriptionArray.description1: Before proceeding with the payment online, the customer must read, understand, and accept the following terms and conditions for the payment facility online.
descriptionArray.description2:
I intend to purchase a residential unit of DarGlobal(“Developer”) and make this online payment(“Token Amount”) towards the initial deposit, for the reservation of the unit(“Reservation”).

 Following this, the Reservation of the unit will be confirmed by the Developer through an official e-mail, subject to the availability of the requested unit at the time of Reservation. 

 I understand and agree that payment of the Token Amount does not ensure the availability of the requested unit. 

 I understand and agree that the payment excludes all applicable bank charges, fees, taxes, and / or commissions.

 I understand and agree that this payment is non - refundable; however, the Developer may agree to issue a refund in its sole discretion.In such cases, refunds will be issued through the original mode of payment.

 I understand and agree that this payment cannot be used in lieu of any other payments due to DarGlobal, this includes payment of any balance, and / or deposits, and / or subsequent instalment(s) due for a reserved or purchased unit
descriptionArray.description3:
The Reservation of the unit will last for a period of seven (7) calendar days (“Reservation Period”), starting from the date the Token Amount was paid. Before the expiry of the Reservation Period, the Customer must pay in full to the Developer, the initial instalment (the “Deposit”) of the purchase price, in addition to signing the Developer’s sale and purchase agreement for the unit (the “SPA”).

 If the Customer fails to pay the Deposit in full and/or sign the SPA within the Reservation Period for any reason whatsoever, the Reservation shall automatically terminate and the Token Amount, along with any other payments made towards the Deposit, shall be forfeited to the Developer, without need for notice, court judgment or any further proceedings (legal or otherwise).

 The Customer acknowledges that additional terms and conditions of the Developer may also apply. DarGlobal reserves their right, at any time and at its absolute discretion, to amend these Terms and Conditions.

title: The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin | Al Marjan Island RAK
paragraphs: The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin is a beachfront residential development on Al Marjan Island, Ras Al Khaimah, by DarGlobal. Residences range from one- to three-bedroom apartments and three-bedroom beach villas, spanning 61 to 265 sqm, with Aston Martin-designed interiors and direct access to the beach on the water's edge.
*   Units 1 to 3-bedroom residences & 3-bedroom beach villas

Each seafront residence is a true work of art. From every angle, you'll witness the obsessive attention to detail that embodies Aston Martin's unwavering dedication to precision and beauty. A true testament to living excellence.

### Ras Al Khaimah, the fourth-largest emirate in the United Arab Emirates, is home to the newly opened RAK Market, which launched just two years ago. Some of the most desirable areas include Al Marjan Island, Al Hamra Village, and Mina Al Arab. Al Marjan Island's development strategy focuses on attracting a broad spectrum of international investors by offering luxurious amenities, serene ocean views, and a resort-style community. The emphasis on beachfront luxury, combined with the promise of high returns, positions Al Marjan Island as a prime destination for investment in the UAE's real estate market. The government has announced the opening of a WYNN Casino on Al Marjan Island itself in 2.5 years. This announcement has doubled market price over the past two years.
### 01 10-year Golden Visa:Available with an investment of 2 million AED
### 02 Attractive Taxation:Enjoy 0% income Tax and 0% Property Tax
### 03 Direct view of WYNN Resort:Just 5 minutes away from the first Wynn Resort in the Middle East
### 04 Direct Beachfront Access:Enjoy stunning Beachfront Residences
### 05 Convenient Location:Only 60 minutes from Dubai International Airport
### 07 High-Yield Opportunities:Potential to generate yields beyond 9% due to saturation in Dubai beachfront locations
### 08 Emerging Market :RAK is experiencing significant growth with an average apartment capital value increase of 35% in the last year
### 09 High Hotel Occupancy Rates:Projected peak in occupancy rate for the hospitality sector by 2027, nearing full capacity, indicated high demand for residential products
### 10 Tourist Influx:Projected to attract 3-3.5 million tourists by 2030, driving rental yields and capital values
### 11 Strong Regulatory Framework:Ensures buyer protection and project completion through RERA and escrow accounts
### 12 Branded Residences:Achieve higher returns with price premiums of 30% to 200% due to perceived quality, prestige, and superior services, attracting high-net-worth buyers

The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin is located on Al Marjan Island, a shining gem on the coastline of Ras Al Khaimah, UAE. This remarkable man-made island offers a luxurious retreat surrounded by pristine beaches and crystal-clear waters. Boasting an array of world-class resorts, upscale residences, and vibrant leisure attractions.

The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin is a beachfront residential development on Al Marjan Island, Ras Al Khaimah, developed by DarGlobal. Aston Martin's design team applied the brand's precision and craftsmanship to each unit, producing a collection of one- to three-bedroom residences and three-bedroom beach villas directly on the water's edge.

The Astera offers one-, two-, and three-bedroom residences and three-bedroom beachfront villas ranging from 61 to 265 sqm. All units feature Aston Martin-designed interiors and sit on Al Marjan Island with direct beach access.

Aston Martin's design team was responsible for the interiors of every residence, applying the brand's approach to precision, material quality, and artisanal craftsmanship to kitchens, bathrooms, and living spaces. The collaboration integrates cutting-edge design with the timeless finishes associated with the Aston Martin brand.

The Astera is under development with handover scheduled for December 2028. DarGlobal is the master developer responsible for delivery on Al Marjan Island. Contact the sales team for current unit availability, pricing, and payment plan terms.

The Astera is on Al Marjan Island, a man-made island off the Ras Al Khaimah coastline, 60 minutes from Dubai International Airport. It sits approximately 5 minutes from the upcoming Wynn Resort on Al Marjan Island, the first casino resort in the Middle East.

Amenities include direct beach access, an infinity pool, spa, sauna, pool bar, fitness centre, indoor cinema, yoga lawn, multipurpose hall, children's play area, and premium 24/7 security. Beach villas offer private access to the shoreline directly from the residence.

AboutProject.title: Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai
AboutProject.description: Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai is the Middle East's first and only Trump-branded address, developed by DarGlobal on Sheikh Zayed Road at the entrance to Downtown Dubai. The development combines a five-star hotel, private residences, and a members-only club in one building. Units span 109 to 722 sqm across one- to three-bedroom apartments and four-bedroom duplex penthouses, with sea or Burj Khalifa views from every unit.

Step inside. Look around. This is what winning looks like. Residences & penthouses 
with soaring ceilings and bespoke finishes. Every inch, a statement of dominance. 
Overlook the shimmering skyline, the grandeur of Burj Khalifa or the limitless sea.
These are the headquarters for the ambitions of visionaries,
disruptors, and game-changers. And you’re next.

descriptionArray.description2:
I intend to purchase a residential unit of DarGlobal(“Developer”) and make this online payment(“Token Amount”) towards the initial deposit, for the reservation of the unit(“Reservation”).

 Following this, the Reservation of the unit will be confirmed by the Developer through an official e-mail, subject to the availability of the requested unit at the time of Reservation. 

 I understand and agree that payment of the Token Amount does not ensure the availability of the requested unit. 

 I understand and agree that the payment excludes all applicable bank charges, fees, taxes, and / or commissions.

 I understand and agree that this payment is non - refundable; however, the Developer may agree to issue a refund in its sole discretion.In such cases, refunds will be issued through the original mode of payment.

 I understand and agree that this payment cannot be used in lieu of any other payments due to DarGlobal, this includes payment of any balance, and / or deposits, and / or subsequent instalment(s) due for a reserved or purchased unit
descriptionArray.description3:
The Reservation of the unit will last for a period of seven (7) calendar days (“Reservation Period”), starting from the date the Token Amount was paid. Before the expiry of the Reservation Period, the Customer must pay in full to the Developer, the initial instalment (the “Deposit”) of the purchase price, in addition to signing the Developer’s sale and purchase agreement for the unit (the “SPA”).

 If the Customer fails to pay the Deposit in full and/or sign the SPA within the Reservation Period for any reason whatsoever, the Reservation shall automatically terminate and the Token Amount, along with any other payments made towards the Deposit, shall be forfeited to the Developer, without need for notice, court judgment or any further proceedings (legal or otherwise).

 The Customer acknowledges that additional terms and conditions of the Developer may also apply. DarGlobal reserves their right, at any time and at its absolute discretion, to amend these Terms and Conditions.

AboutProject.title: A Timeless Classic
AboutProject.description:
Originally known as Gloucestor House, Nº149 Old Park Lane is a sophisticated landmark building with an important role in London’s architectural heritage.
Situated on the corner of Old Park Lane and Piccadilly, overlooking Green Park. Nº149 is one of the finest Grade II properties on Old Park Lane. It has been meticulously redeveloped and designed to the highest of standards throughout.

PhotoGallery.title: A Momentous Welcome
PhotoGallery.description: Welcomed by a century of traditional architecture, The Mulliner salutes residents and guests with its traditionally refined entrance. It has retained many of the original classical and Art Nouveau features of the original design.

AboutProject.title: A Paradise by the Shore.
AboutProject.description: A lifetime of golden sunsets awaits you at Les Vagues by Elie Saab. Situated in Qetaifan Island North, a place of unimaginable beauty, is paradise on earth for haute couture living. Where opulent sea-front residences are nestled alongside luxurious beach resorts, private beaches, clubhouses, world-class boating facilities, boutique shopping experiences, a water park, and a winter garden. These beautiful residences are poised to emerge as the epitome of exclusivity

PhotoGallery.title: Photo Gallery
PhotoGallery.description: The interiors at Les Vagues offers a spectacular grace where shapes and colors blend harmoniously. Shades of creams and grey, metals with shiny finishes, bronze, marble and premium stone, are considered with a level of exquisite craftsmanship rarely seen. One that leaves a lasting impression of refined elegance, one that could only come from the world’s leading haute couture designer ELIE SAAB.

Where opulent sea-front residences are nestled alongside luxurious beach resorts, private beaches, clubhouses, world-class boating facilities, boutique shopping experiences, a water park, and a winter garden. These beautiful residences are poised to emerge as the epitome of exclusivity

Shades of creams and grey, metals with shiny finishes, bronze, marble and premium stone, are considered with a level of exquisite craftsmanship rarely seen. One that leaves a lasting impression of refined elegance, one that could only come from the world’s leading haute couture designer ELIE SAAB.

A man-made paradise on earth, Qetaifan Island North is 1.3 million square meters of picturesque luxuriousness destined to become an internationally recognized landmark and a symbol of Qatar’s burgeoning future.
Welcome to a designer legacy, where craftsmanship meets innovation, and creativity knows no bounds.

Why INVEST Within a short period of time, the State of Qatar has made great strides. descriptionArray.description1: Before proceeding with the payment online, the customer must read, understand, and accept the following terms and conditions for the payment facility online.
descriptionArray.description2:
I intend to purchase a residential unit of DarGlobal(“Developer”) and make this online payment(“Token Amount”) towards the initial deposit, for the reservation of the unit(“Reservation”).

 Following this, the Reservation of the unit will be confirmed by the Developer through an official e-mail, subject to the availability of the requested unit at the time of Reservation. 

 I understand and agree that payment of the Token Amount does not ensure the availability of the requested unit. 

 I understand and agree that the payment excludes all applicable bank charges, fees, taxes, and / or commissions.

 I understand and agree that this payment is non - refundable; however, the Developer may agree to issue a refund in its sole discretion.In such cases, refunds will be issued through the original mode of payment.

 I understand and agree that this payment cannot be used in lieu of any other payments due to DarGlobal, this includes payment of any balance, and / or deposits, and / or subsequent instalment(s) due for a reserved or purchased unit
descriptionArray.description3:
The Reservation of the unit will last for a period of seven (7) calendar days (“Reservation Period”), starting from the date the Token Amount was paid. Before the expiry of the Reservation Period, the Customer must pay in full to the Developer, the initial instalment (the “Deposit”) of the purchase price, in addition to signing the Developer’s sale and purchase agreement for the unit (the “SPA”).

 If the Customer fails to pay the Deposit in full and/or sign the SPA within the Reservation Period for any reason whatsoever, the Reservation shall automatically terminate and the Token Amount, along with any other payments made towards the Deposit, shall be forfeited to the Developer, without need for notice, court judgment or any further proceedings (legal or otherwise).

 The Customer acknowledges that additional terms and conditions of the Developer may also apply. DarGlobal reserves their right, at any time and at its absolute discretion, to amend these Terms and Conditions.

 If the Customer fails to pay the Deposit in full and/or sign the SPA within the Reservation Period for any reason whatsoever, the Reservation shall automatically terminate and the Token Amount, along with any other payments made towards the Deposit, shall be forfeited to the Developer, without need for notice, court judgment or any further proceedings (legal or otherwise).

faqs.question: What is Neptune, Interiors by Mouawad?

children.text: Neptune, Interiors by Mouawad is a collection of luxury branded villas in northern Riyadh, developed by DarGlobal. Mouawad, the internationally renowned jewellery house, designed the interiors of each five-bedroom villa, bringing its signature approach to refined finishes, artisanal craftsmanship, and timeless elegance to a residential setting.

faqs.question: What did Mouawad design at Neptune?

children.text: Mouawad provided the full interior design across each Neptune villa, applying the brand's heritage in precision and luxury material quality to every room from the entry foyer and living spaces through to the master suite, bathrooms, and kitchen. The collaboration translates Mouawad's jewellery-house sensibility into an architectural and residential context.

faqs.question: What villa sizes are available at Neptune?

children.text: Neptune offers five-bedroom villas with built-up areas ranging from 300 to 420 sqm. Each villa includes a master bedroom with walk-in closet and en-suite, secondary bedrooms, a family kitchen, guest living area, and terrace with views of the surrounding landscape.

faqs.question: When will Neptune, Interiors by Mouawad be completed?

children.text: The project is under development with completion scheduled for December 2027. DarGlobal is the master developer. Contact the sales team for current unit availability, pricing, and payment plan terms, or explore available villas via the online residence navigator.

faqs.question: Where is Neptune, Interiors by Mouawad located?

children.text: Neptune is in the northern district of Riyadh, positioned in close proximity to the Expo 2030 Riyadh site, placing residents at the centre of one of Saudi Arabia's most significant urban development corridors under Vision 2030.

faqs.question: What community amenities surround Neptune?

children.text: The Neptune community is supported by schools, a community centre, sports hub, restaurants and cafes, public parks, entertainment centres, early childhood centres, retail and grocery, playgrounds, mosques, and healthcare clinics within the wider neighbourhood.

faqs.question: Is Riyadh real estate open to foreign investors?

children.text: Yes. Full freehold ownership is now available to foreign investors in Saudi Arabia. Property investment of 4 million SAR or more qualifies buyers for residency eligibility. The Saudi Riyal is pegged to the US Dollar, providing currency stability, and Saudi Arabia applies 0% capital gains tax, 0% wealth tax, and 0% inheritance tax.

faqs.question: Why invest in Riyadh property under Saudi Vision 2030?

children.text: Riyadh is set to host the FIFA World Cup 2034, Expo 2030, Formula 1, and the Asian Games, driving unprecedented infrastructure investment. King Salman International Airport is scaling to 185 million passengers, and Riyadh Air is expanding global connectivity. Saudi Arabia is considered one of the safest countries globally and the safest in the G20.

faqs.question: What makes Neptune a limited-edition collection?

children.text: Neptune is positioned as a limited edition collection, meaning a restricted number of villas are available, each featuring bespoke Mouawad interiors and individual design attention that cannot be replicated at scale. The scarcity of a Mouawad-branded residential product in Riyadh places it in a distinct tier above standard luxury villa developments in the city.

children.text: Buyers can register interest, explore available villas via the online residence navigator, or download the project brochure through DarGlobal at darglobal.co.uk. The sales team can confirm current availability, pricing, and payment plan details on request.

The Saudi Riyal is pegged to the US Dollar, providing currency stability, and Saudi Arabia applies 0% capital gains tax, 0% wealth tax, and 0% inheritance tax.
Why invest in Riyadh property under Saudi Vision 2030?
Riyadh is set to host the FIFA World Cup 2034, Expo 2030, Formula 1, and the Asian Games, driving unprecedented infrastructure investment. King Salman International Airport is scaling to 185 million passengers, and Riyadh Air is expanding global connectivity. Saudi Arabia is considered one of the safest countries globally and the safest in the G20.
What makes Neptune a limited-edition collection?
Neptune is positioned as a limited edition collection, meaning a restricted number of villas are available, each featuring bespoke Mouawad interiors and individual design attention that cannot be replicated at scale. The scarcity of a Mouawad-branded residential product in Riyadh places it in a distinct tier above standard luxury villa developments in the city.
How do I register interest or buy a villa at Neptune?
Buyers can register interest, explore available villas via the online residence navigator, or download the project brochure through DarGlobal at darglobal.co.uk. The sales team can confirm current availability, pricing, and payment plan details on request.

Amaya is a 1-million-square-meter master-planned community by Dar Global in central Jeddah. In addition to completed villas and custom land plots, Amaya offers townhouses, mid-to-high-rise residential and commercial plots, and branded or serviced residences, including Trump Plaza.

Jeddah is one of Saudi Arabia's largest and most active real estate markets, driven by its status as a commercial hub and gateway city on the Red Sea coast. Demand for residential property in Jeddah is supported by a growing population, ongoing infrastructure investment, and ambitious national development plans under Saudi Vision 2030. Villas and land plots, like those offered at **Amaya**, tend to appeal to buyers seeking long-term ownership and the option to customize their homes. For buyers considering the Gulf Cooperation Council region, Jeddah offers a relatively stable entry point into a maturing property market with room for continued growth.

Pricing for villas and land plots at **Amaya** in Jeddah depends on unit size, plot dimensions, and current inventory availability. DarGlobal has not published a fixed price list for the community, as costs vary based on the specific villa type or plot chosen. Buyers interested in **Amaya** should reach out directly to DarGlobal or an authorized sales representative to get up-to-date pricing for available units. This approach ensures buyers receive accurate figures reflecting the latest release phase and any applicable offers.

Amaya sits in a prime central location along King Abdulaziz Road, directly opposite the Red Sea Mall and minutes from the Jeddah Corniche. This gives buyers a coastal lifestyle address with direct connectivity to key urban and historic hubs.

Amaya offers full freehold ownership options for foreign buyers. Additionally, qualifying real estate investments at Amaya may enable eligible international buyers to apply for the Saudi Premium Residency.

In addition to nearby schools, medical clinics, and mosques, Amaya features signature community amenities. These include a 700-meter central parkland, shaded green walking trails, integrated retail courtyards, and the 4,000-square-meter members-only Vitality Club.

descriptionArray.description2:
I intend to purchase a residential unit of DarGlobal(“Developer”) and make this online payment(“Token Amount”) towards the initial deposit, for the reservation of the unit(“Reservation”).

 Following this, the Reservation of the unit will be confirmed by the Developer through an official e-mail, subject to the availability of the requested unit at the time of Reservation. 

 I understand and agree that payment of the Token Amount does not ensure the availability of the requested unit. 

 I understand and agree that the payment excludes all applicable bank charges, fees, taxes, and / or commissions.

 I understand and agree that this payment is non - refundable; however, the Developer may agree to issue a refund in its sole discretion.In such cases, refunds will be issued through the original mode of payment.

 I understand and agree that this payment cannot be used in lieu of any other payments due to DarGlobal, this includes payment of any balance, and / or deposits, and / or subsequent instalment(s) due for a reserved or purchased unit
descriptionArray.description3:
The Reservation of the unit will last for a period of seven (7) calendar days (“Reservation Period”), starting from the date the Token Amount was paid. Before the expiry of the Reservation Period, the Customer must pay in full to the Developer, the initial instalment (the “Deposit”) of the purchase price, in addition to signing the Developer’s sale and purchase agreement for the unit (the “SPA”).

 If the Customer fails to pay the Deposit in full and/or sign the SPA within the Reservation Period for any reason whatsoever, the Reservation shall automatically terminate and the Token Amount, along with any other payments made towards the Deposit, shall be forfeited to the Developer, without need for notice, court judgment or any further proceedings (legal or otherwise).

 The Customer acknowledges that additional terms and conditions of the Developer may also apply. DarGlobal reserves their right, at any time and at its absolute discretion, to amend these Terms and Conditions.

paragraphs: Trump Cliff Villas is a collection of fully furnished three-bedroom villas at AIDA, Muscat, developed by DarGlobal. Positioned beside the Trump International Hotel, 130 metres above the Muscat Riviera, each villa ranges from 128 to 166 sqm and features a private pool overlooking the sea. Owners receive a Golf Club Social Membership and the flexibility to reside in or lease the villa.

The Cliff Villas are fully furnished and meticulously designed, crafted, and curated to provide the highest standard of living. Every detail, down to the last teacup, is furnished to perfection, making these villas the best in the world.

Under the management of Trump, these furnished villas provide the choice to reside or lease, ensuring the hallmark quality and service associated with the esteemed Trump brand. Living in these villas offers the best sea views and closest access to unparalleled amenities.

Located in Muscat and just 25 minutes from the international airport, AIDA rises 130 metres above sea level as a city within a city, combining nature, hospitality, and a championship golf destination.

Trump Cliff Villas are a collection of fully furnished three-bedroom sea-view villas at AIDA, Muscat, developed by DarGlobal. Each villa is positioned directly beside the Trump International Hotel at 130 metres above the Muscat Riviera, with a private pool overlooking the sea. Villas are designed and furnished to the highest standard, with every detail specified down to specification.

Trump Cliff Villas offer three-bedroom furnished residences from 128 to 166 sqm. Each villa includes a private pool with sea views. Owners receive a Trump International Golf Club Social Membership as part of the purchase and have the option to reside in or lease the villa.

Trump Cliff Villas offer full villa ownership with a private pool, the closest positioning to the Trump International Hotel, and the most elevated sea views on the AIDA estate. Unlike Trump Golf Villas, which face the golf course, These villas are positioned on the cliff edge with direct sea orientation. Both villa products sit within the same AIDA estate and share access to the same championship golf course and community facilities.

Within the AIDA estate, villa owners have access to the Trump International Golf Club Oman (18-hole championship course), Trump Members Only Club, The SHFT Night Club, 5-star dining and culinary facilities, AIDA Beach, Trump Hotels Hanging Suites, a Trump International Hotel lobby, community and retail centres, plazas, cafes and restaurants, wellness centres, fitness centre, promenades, hiking trails, mountain bike trails, running trail, viewing decks, and outdoor landscapes across the cliffside estate.

Completion is scheduled for December 2028. Construction is underway and live progress feeds are available on the DarGlobal project page. Contact DarGlobal at darglobal.co.uk to book a unit, choose your residence via the online navigator, or download the project brochure.

paragraphs: 130 meters above the Muscat Riviera. Trump Golf Villas positioned along the Trump International Championship Golf Course, with open golf and sea views. Every residence includes a branded golf cart for effortless access across the estate.

Live the power of status. These luxurious residences represent the pinnacle of society, providing a gateway to a parallel world of unmatched. These spaces are meticulously designed and crafted with the utmost precision, aiming to provide the highest standard of sophisticated living.

Aristocratic at first sight. With stunning views, luxurious amenities, and an array of activities to enjoy, the Trump Golf Villas at AIDA are the pinnacle of perfection. Additionally, it is in close proximity to 5-star landmark destinations including, the Ritz Carlton, The Shangri-La Resort, Nikki Beach, and Jumeirah Muscat Bay.
AIDA envelops communities with enchanting experiences and premium amenities.

Trump Golf Villas are a collection of five-bedroom luxury villas at AIDA, Muscat, developed by DarGlobal. Each villa is positioned directly along the Trump International Championship Golf Course, 130 metres above the Muscat Riviera, with open views across the fairways and the sea. Every residence includes a branded golf cart for private use across the estate.

The villas are within the AIDA estate in Muscat, Oman, 25 minutes from Muscat International Airport. The estate sits in close proximity to a cluster of 5-star hospitality landmarks including the Ritz Carlton, Shangri-La Resort, Nikki Beach, and Jumeirah Muscat Bay Hotel.

Trump Golf Villas offer five-bedroom residences from 4,367 sqft. Villas include open terraces and balconies with dual golf and sea views, and each unit comes with a complimentary branded golf cart for use across the AIDA estate. Contact DarGlobal for current unit availability and pricing.

AIDA provides access to the Trump International Golf Club Oman, gated community security, wellness centres, a fitness centre, plazas, cafes and restaurants, hiking trails, mountain biking routes, running trails, a viewing deck, parks and recreational spaces, luxury hotel neighbours, and extensive outdoor landscaping across the cliffside estate.

Completion is scheduled for December 2028. Construction is actively underway. Live progress feeds are available on the DarGlobal project page. Contact the sales team at darglobal.co.uk for current availability and payment plan details.

descriptionArray.description2:
I intend to purchase a residential unit of DarGlobal(“Developer”) and make this online payment(“Token Amount”) towards the initial deposit, for the reservation of the unit(“Reservation”).

 Following this, the Reservation of the unit will be confirmed by the Developer through an official e-mail, subject to the availability of the requested unit at the time of Reservation. 

 I understand and agree that payment of the Token Amount does not ensure the availability of the requested unit. 

 I understand and agree that the payment excludes all applicable bank charges, fees, taxes, and / or commissions.

 I understand and agree that this payment is non - refundable; however, the Developer may agree to issue a refund in its sole discretion.In such cases, refunds will be issued through the original mode of payment.

 I understand and agree that this payment cannot be used in lieu of any other payments due to DarGlobal, this includes payment of any balance, and / or deposits, and / or subsequent instalment(s) due for a reserved or purchased unit
descriptionArray.description3:
The Reservation of the unit will last for a period of seven (7) calendar days (“Reservation Period”), starting from the date the Token Amount was paid. Before the expiry of the Reservation Period, the Customer must pay in full to the Developer, the initial instalment (the “Deposit”) of the purchase price, in addition to signing the Developer’s sale and purchase agreement for the unit (the “SPA”).

 If the Customer fails to pay the Deposit in full and/or sign the SPA within the Reservation Period for any reason whatsoever, the Reservation shall automatically terminate and the Token Amount, along with any other payments made towards the Deposit, shall be forfeited to the Developer, without need for notice, court judgment or any further proceedings (legal or otherwise).

 The Customer acknowledges that additional terms and conditions of the Developer may also apply. DarGlobal reserves their right, at any time and at its absolute discretion, to amend these Terms and Conditions.

title: Trump International Simaisma, Qatar
paragraphs: DarGlobal and The Trump Organization, in collaboration with Qatari Diar, bring Trump International Simaisma, Qatar to Qatar’s eastern coast. Set within the 8 million sqm Simaisma destination, the project is surrounded by 7 km of waterfront, with access to leisure, hospitality, entertainment, golf, marina, dining and retail experiences.

Part of an evolving waterfront destination, Trump International Simaisma, Qatar combines privacy with convenient access to golf, leisure, family attractions, healthcare and the surrounding natural landscapes.
Featuring a dedicated Community Centre exclusively for residents, and Beach Club.
Golden Visa: Renewable residency with an investment of $200,000
Globally Recognised Name: A residential destination associated with The Trump Organization.
Private Setting by the Sea: A waterfront location within one of Qatar’s key master-planned destinations.
Limited Collection: An exclusive collection of twin and attached seaside villas.
Championship Golf: An 18-hole golf course and private club lifestyle.
Integrated Lifestyle: Golf, dining, wellbeing, recreation and community amenities in one destination.
Exceptional Connectivity: Approximately 40 kilometres north of Doha, with easy access to Lusail, Doha and Hamad International Airport.
Timeless Design: Architecture and materials designed for enduring quality.

Set along Qatar’s eastern coast, approximately 40 kilometres north of Doha, Trump International Simaisma, Qatar offers a more private seaside setting while keeping Lusail and Hamad International Airport comfortably accessible. It brings together resort hospitality, entertainment, marina life, golf, residences and leisure within one evolving destination.
